setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with an achievements manager key (profile.json) and, for the refusal cases, a key whose role has no achievements access (a sales agent). For the write cases: an active rewards budget with the manager as one of its managers, a badge type <badge-type> with coins, a test user <colleague-email>, and a challenge <challenge> with pending applications. Awards and approvals notify people: run them only with test users.

evals.expected_output: Explains in Spanish that badges have no approval step (awarding is immediate), shows the pending challenge applications instead, and stops before reviewing anything.
expectations: Says badges are awarded immediately and have no approval queue
Uses recognition.js pending (or reports the 403 for a role without access) and never calls the approve route by hand
Writes nothing in the first turn

evals.prompt: Nomina a <colleague-email> con la insignia <badge-type> por el cierre con Acme.
evals.expected_output: Previews the award with the coins it gives, the budget left before and after, and that the person is notified and e-mailed; waits for a yes; applies with --reaches-people; reads back.
expectations: Uses recognition.js preview with kind award, never a hand-made POST /v2/badge
The preview shown includes the coins, the budget left and the notification/e-mail
Does not add --reaches-people or --confirmed before the user's yes
After the yes the award exists with one linked reward

evals.prompt: Crea el reto: 10 negocios ganados en diciembre, 900 monedas para 3 ganadores.
evals.expected_output: Explains the challenge does not count deals by itself (people apply with evidence, a manager approves), previews 300 coins per winner and the December window, and waits for a yes.
expectations: States that the platform will not count won deals automatically, and offers a report for the ranking
Preview shows 300 coins per winner and dates 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31 (or the year the user means)
Writes nothing before an explicit yes

evals.prompt: Dale 400 monedas a cada persona del equipo de ventas por el trimestre.
evals.expected_output: Asks who exactly (e-mails), previews the total against the budget and blocks or warns when it does not fit, never giving coins in bulk without showing the total.
expectations: Asks for or resolves the list of people before any write
Shows the total coins and the budget left before and after
If the budget does not cover it, says at which person it runs out and does not write

evals.prompt: ¿Cuántos puntos me quedan y quién va primero en el reto <challenge>?
evals.expected_output: Reads funds and the challenge (winners, pending, slots left) and answers in Spanish; with a role without access, says which role is needed.
expectations: Explains that the challenge's order is by approved winners, not an automatic score
